mode: generate with one Steam header as a visual reference per concept
inputRole: Reference image for general lettering/composition principles, not an edit target. No foreign logos are composited into output.

specs.name: 시간의 첫 글자
specs.direction: Principle to extract: the first character physically incorporates a time symbol and anchors a compact dynamic title. New design: create a strong FIRST A whose negative counter contains an incomplete silver clock rim and two small still hands; the A must remain unmistakably A, never a C. The rest STELLA are substantial sharp custom capitals with a slight rising, flowing perspective to the baseline, original proportions and clean counters. The whole word forms a confident shallow diagonal sweep. Brushed pearly-silver relief, amethyst only in clock recesses, tiny engraved ticks. The clock belongs INSIDE the first A, not a big watch case behind the name. Do not copy the source's C dial, its two-word layout, red/gold palette or character art.
specs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE ORIGINAL title wordmark for the fantasy RPG ASTELLA, inspired by a VISUAL DESIGN PRINCIPLE from the provided Steam header reference, not by copying its logo.
EXACT MAIN TEXT: "ASTELLA", seven clear uppercase Latin letters A S T E L L A in that order. No other text, game names, taglines, Korean, numerals or credits.
Image 1 is a reference to study the lettering/composition ONLY. Do not reproduce its characters, creatures, setting, trademark emblem, exact letter shapes, original words, distinctive mask or original colour scheme. Build a new ASTELLA alphabet and a new silhouette.
Astella identity: pale silver and cool ivory, dark indigo outlines, restrained amethyst-violet accents; an enchanted crystal woodland and a story of expeditions, a clock tower and stopped time. Finished, intentional fantasy game title art, rich enough for a commercial title screen, carefully drawn letter bodies. Let the main strokes stay extremely readable at 600px wide. Use subtle sculpted depth where appropriate, without covering the word in jewellery.
One self-contained horizontal wordmark on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, approximately 3:1 to 3.5:1, complete safe margins and no clipped flourishes. No background panel, forest, characters, UI, fake checkerboard, floor, watermark or presentation sheet.

The whole word forms a confident shallow diagonal sweep. Brushed pearly-silver relief, amethyst only in clock recesses, tiny engraved ticks. specs.name: 보라의 각인
specs.direction: Principle to extract: a single letter with striking scale and accent colour establishes the identity. New design: ASTELL are original slender ivory-silver gothic-inspired capitals, sharp carved but highly readable; the FINAL A is about 1.35 times the cap height, with deep amethyst enamel faces and fine silver edges. Keep ASTELLA on one readable baseline with the final A rising as the distinctive anchor. A thin newly designed stopped-hand line flows from that final A into one short restrained engraving curve. Asymmetric vertical emphasis, crisp negative spaces and small sculpted bevels. Do not reproduce the P, red colour, stacked LIES/of/P layout, source swashes or character portrait. Only ASTELLA is visible.

specs.name: 원정의 명각
specs.direction: Principle to extract: strong size hierarchy and typography itself acting as ornament. New design: ASTELLA is the large foreground title in an original high-contrast elegant serif alphabet, with generous deliberate spacing, thin hairline serifs, broad clean verticals and a lightly worn SILVER-LEAF surface. A much thinner, lower-contrast incomplete engraved clock impression sits partly BEHIND the LOWER half of the name, giving an airy second layer of large curved geometry and a few ticks. The large word reads first; the broad quiet clock impression reads second. Restrained cinematic graphic design, shallow pressed-metal depth and subtle amethyst shadows rather than heavy faceted jewellery. No secondary word, no numbers such as 33 or XII, no huge emblem, no source lettering, gold palette, characters or landscape.

specs.name: 빛의 필사
specs.referenceGame: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
specs.direction: Principle to extract: large organic hand-painted strokes, with light and stroke ends providing identity. New design: clearly readable uppercase ASTELLA made from generous original asymmetrical brush strokes, soft irregular tapers, open triangular As, a flowing S, branching-but-readable T/E and two separate Ls. Not a conventional Roman serif font and not literal tree branches. Silver-white luminous cores, faint lavender and amethyst reflections along sculptural stroke edges, visible painterly bristle grain, clean dark-indigo definition. The strokes feel like pearly light-ink with tangible shallow body, not chrome. Airy, magical, inviting and linked to a violet woodland. Tiny imperfections are intentional. No separate jewel, ring, clock, creature, leaf wreath, dot over a letter, source O/R/I letter shapes, source subtitle or forest scene.

specs.name: 태엽의 문장
specs.direction: Principle to extract: readable slender lettering framed by balanced ornament ABOVE and BELOW, with the letter interiors left clear. New design: ASTELLA in an original slender, slightly elongated ivory-silver ceremonial serif alphabet with carefully spaced capitals. Newly drawn symmetric CLOCKWORK FILIGREE above and below: two small flat spring spirals and short fine gear-tooth motifs joined by elegant silver hairlines, airy open sides. One tiny violet pivot pin at the centre, no face or mask. Thin engraved metal with slight enamel depth and narrow lavender shadow. Ornament supports the legibility and has strong intentional symmetry; no heavy enclosing plaque. Do not reproduce source scroll patterns, the insect/skull/mask emblem, source lettering or characters. Only ASTELLA, no subtitle.
